meta.title: Real Estate & Property Flipping | ASSETRA Investments
meta.description: We acquire undervalued properties, renovate them, and sell at a significant profit. We specialise in property flipping in Slovakia.

hero.label: Our Sector
hero.title: Real Estate
hero.description: We specialise in acquiring undervalued properties, carrying out comprehensive renovations, and selling them at market price.

intro: We seek distressed and undervalued residential properties in the Slovak market. After acquisition, we add value through comprehensive renovation and sell at fair market price.

howItWorks.label: How property flipping works
howItWorks.description: Our business model is built on purchasing properties at least 20% below market value, renovating them, and selling them on.

acquisition.title: Acquisition
acquisition.text: We source properties below market value — foreclosures, estates, urgent sales.

reconstruction.title: Renovation
reconstruction.text: Comprehensive refurbishment with our own team. We focus on maximising value while controlling costs.

sale.title: Sale
sale.text: We sell the property at fair market price. Typical margin is 20% or more.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.text: The full cycle takes 12–36 months. Capital is reinvested into new projects.

margin.label: Target Margin
margin.text: We target a minimum 20% profit margin on every project.

cycles.label: Month Cycles
cycles.text: Short investment horizons with defined exit points.

market.label: Market
market.text: We focus on the Slovak residential market.

assets.label: Assets
assets.text: Every project is backed by a physical property.

cta.heading: Interested in investing?
cta.text: Fixed 12% annual return secured by real property. Fill out a non-binding form.
